fields.name: 2 Seater Sofa
fields.description:
Sectional/Modular Sofas: These are versatile, multi-piece sofas that can be arranged in various configurations (like L-shaped or U-shaped) to fit different room layouts. They are excellent for maximizing seating in large open-plan areas or utilizing corner space in compact apartments.
Curved Sofas: Making a major comeback, curved sofas add architectural interest and softness to a room, encouraging conversation and creating an inviting flow. They work beautifully as statement pieces, often floated in the middle of a room.
Chesterfield Sofas: A classic and timeless design known for its distinctive deep button tufting and rolled arms that are the same height as the backrest. This style often uses luxurious materials like leather or velvet to add a traditional, sophisticated feel to a space.

fields.name: Single chair
fields.description:
Adjustable Lumbar Support: This is a non-negotiable feature for true back support, helping maintain the natural S-shape of your spine.
Adjustable Height and Depth: The seat height should allow your feet to rest flat on the floor with your thighs parallel to the ground. Seat depth adjustment ensures proper back contact with the backrest.
Breathable Material: A mesh backrest is particularly beneficial in warmer climates as it allows for optimal airflow, keeping you cool and comfortable.
Adjustable Armrests and Headrest: Armrests should support your arms so your shoulders can remain relaxed, while a headrest supports the neck and head to prevent strain.
